verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Anthropic's docs mostly describe capabilities, pricing, and API mechanics; the closest thing to failure-mode disclosure is a safety-focused system card (risk-area testing) and a narrow feature note that thinking can't be disabled on one model — neither constitutes documented capability weaknesses or task-level jagged edges. Reports of the model being 'stupid' or inconsistent come only from community/HN threads, not vendor docs, so they don't satisfy the 'in its own docs' requirement.
